main.title: About
text: Recent computer science graduate focused on frontend development. I care about responsive design and accessibility, and I am eager to learn testing and state management in a professional team.

items.heading: Recipe Finder (graduation project)
bullets: Single-page app in React that consumes a public recipes REST API.
Implemented infinite scroll, client-side caching and a dark theme.
Deployed on Netlify with a GitHub-based workflow.

items.heading: Accessible Form Library
bullets: Small set of form components with ARIA labels and keyboard navigation, written in TS.

items.heading: Teaching Assistant — Web Programming course
bullets: Helped 60 students with HTML, CSS and JavaScript lab assignments.
